name: ExeBlueprint

summary.zh-TW: 整理 Windows 執行檔與應用程式套件的檔案、技術、相依關係及程式結構，輸出 Markdown 報告與 JSON。
summary.en: Inspects Windows binaries and application packages, then exports file, technology, dependency and code-structure information as Markdown and JSON.

descriptionScope.releasePolicy: Capabilities describe the current main source, not every downloadable release. Consult the selected release notes.
descriptionScope.maintenance: Update this profile with README.md, README.en.md and the source contracts when capabilities change.
descriptionScope.pathBase: Repository root; all sourcePaths and documentation paths below are relative to that root.

audience: Scripts and external AI tools consuming analysis results

execution.optionalAnalysisBackend: Ghidra headless for native PE functions and static CALL references
execution.missingOptionalBackend: Continue other analysis and record why native analysis was skipped.

outputs.purpose: Structured analysis result; this is not the product profile
Types, signatures and supported method bodies; compilation is not guaranteed
Type and method-signature skeletons; empty method bodies
Type and method-signature skeletons; empty method bodies
Type and method-signature skeletons; empty method bodies

featureStatusDefinitions.partial: Implemented for a supported subset; limitations apply.
featureStatusDefinitions.optional: Requires an additional backend or explicit option.
featureStatusDefinitions.planned: Not implemented; not a current product capability.

features.summary: File hashes, PE structure, imports and assembly references.
Bounded ZIP and ASAR expansion, including nested ASAR, with incomplete-result reporting.
Common language, runtime, framework and installer fingerprints with confidence and evidence.
features.limitation: Detection does not prove the source language or imply support for its reconstruction.

features.summary: .NET types, members, IL and method call graphs.
Standard .resources values, bounded pre-serialized-resource envelopes and WPF BAML structure.
features.limitation: No execution of resource converters and no full UI reconstruction.

features.summary: Value-free summaries of embedded JSON, XML and .config structure.
features.limitation: This applies to configuration summaries, not redaction of every string in the report.

features.summary: .NET type and signature skeletons, supported method bodies and package-local project references.
features.limitation: Unrecovered methods retain IL and use NotImplementedException; compilation and behavioral equivalence are not guaranteed.

features.summary: C++, Rust and Go type and method-signature skeletons from managed code.
features.limitation: Method bodies remain empty; this is not general cross-language program conversion.

features.verificationLimit: Parser and exporter fixture tests are available; real Ghidra execution acceptance is still pending.
features.summary: Ghidra function inventory and static CALL references with call sites and direct/indirect flags.
features.limitation: Unresolved targets and truncation are recorded. Indirect runtime targets may be incomplete; jump-based tail calls and native code reconstruction are not supported.

features.summary: File/folder selection, drag and drop, recent successful inputs, progress and cancellation.

planned: Outer Inno Setup, NSIS, MSI, PyInstaller and Electron installer extraction
Native tail-call analysis and code reconstruction
Deeper type-specific UI and resource summaries
Broader support for compilable multi-project C# reconstruction
E-language, VB6 and Delphi to C# conversion
Method-body reconstruction for C++, Rust and Go generators
Behavioral comparison between original and reconstructed programs

resultReading.incompleteData: Inspect truncation, completeness and error fields at their documented level. Missing data is not proof of absence.

nativeNullSemantics.files[].nativeCode: No native analysis result was supplied for this file.
nativeNullSemantics.files[].nativeCode.callGraph: No call graph was supplied; not the same as a scanned graph with zero calls.
nativeNullSemantics.files[].nativeCode.callGraph.calls[].tar: This retained call's target was unresolved.

resultReading.sensitiveContent: Reports may contain program strings and embedded resources. Review before sharing with people or external AI services.
